name: CSN 817 强风切变 浓雾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 817, you are at gate 213, you have got information G, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 817，在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 G，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 817, gate 213, information G, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 817，213 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，起始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 3115，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and engine have been started up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出并已开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 817, push backand start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 817，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，谨慎滑行，A 滑行道以东有人和设备作业。

cards.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 817, we encountered strong wind shear between 200 meters and 400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 817，我们在 200 米至 400 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 8400 米巡航，接近 DAPRO，与广州管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 817, maintaining 8400 meters, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 817，保持 8400 米，接近 DAPRO。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，广州管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。

cards.audioText: B: As you are descending to 4200 meters, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你下降至 4200 米时，执行了 TCAS RA 爬升机动，向管制员报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 817, descending to 4200 meters, TCAS climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 817，下降至 4200 米，TCAS 爬升。

cards.audioText: B: Now the conflicting traffic is clear, resumed descent, report the situation to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在冲突飞机已脱离，恢复下降，向管制员报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 817, clear of traffic, resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 817，冲突已解除，恢复下降。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, continue descent to 3600 meters.
B: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, tell the controller you can't see the PAPI lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，告诉管制员你看不到 PAPI 灯。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 817, established on ILS approach Runway 36R, we can't see the PAPI lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 817，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们看不到 PAPI 灯。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, cleared to land Runway 36R, the PAPI is out of service.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，跑道 36R 可以落地，PAPI 不工作。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land Runway 36R, CSN 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以落地，CSN 817。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, due to the thick fog, you can't find the taxiway clearly, ask Tower for a follow-me car to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于浓雾，你看不清滑行道，向塔台请求引导车滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 817, due to the thick fog, we can't find the taxiway clearly, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 817，由于浓雾，我们看不清滑行道，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 817, the follow-me car will be waiting for you on the taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 817，引导车将在 A 滑行道上等你。
